metadata.risk_matrix: Risk follows the KRNO DSS method: determine hazard impact level from the approved threshold table, then apply the likelihood-vs-impact matrix when a probability is available. Deterministic-only fields use the impact category directly and are flagged with deterministic likelihood metadata.

WIND.source: NBM hourly wind / QMD 24-hour max gust

FLASH_FREEZE.source: NBM hourly temperature probabilities + wet-surface proxy

TEMPERATURE.source: NBM/QMD temperature probabilities with KRNO heat thresholds
NBM/QMD 3-hour temperature probabilities with KRNO heat thresholds

snow.basis: Core NBM snow amount/probability fields are mapped to the KRNO snow impact table, then probability thresholds are passed through the likelihood-vs-impact matrix.

impact_thresholds.label: Minor
impact_thresholds.threshold: Trace to 0.5 inches per native window

impact_thresholds.label: Extreme
impact_thresholds.threshold: Greater than 2 inches per native window

rain.basis: Core NBM 1-hour precipitation drives the timeline. QMD precipitation probabilities are used where available for accumulation summary products. All rain values are mapped to the KRNO rain/flooding impact table.

fzra.basis: Core NBM freezing-rain/ice fields are mapped to the KRNO freezing rain impact table, then probability thresholds are passed through the likelihood-vs-impact matrix where available.

temperature.basis: Cold thresholds use the KRNO fixed cold impact table. Heat thresholds use the day-of-year KRNO heat-risk table in data/krno_heat_thresholds.csv. QMD TMP probability-of-threshold exceedance is mapped through the likelihood-vs-impact matrix for the 72-hour card and timeline.

precip_type_conflict: Evaluate freezing rain first when probability/amount exceeds threshold.
Then evaluate snow when probability/amount and temperature support snow.
Allow mixed/transition wording when rain and snow signals overlap near the temperature threshold.

future_admin_config.hazards: Enabled variables, row order, labels, thresholds, tooltips
future_admin_config.timeline: Horizon, native windows, display windows, card aggregation rules
